reason: The README describes a Windows watchdog plugin whose primary purpose is monitoring the dsh web GUI, recording crashes, automatically restarting the host, and exposing status and restart controls through a panel and local API.

summaries.zh: 用于监控 dsh Web GUI、记录崩溃信息、按退避策略自动重启宿主进程，并提供状态查看与计划重启控制。
summaries.en: Monitors the dsh web GUI, records crash information, automatically restarts the host with backoff, and provides status and planned-restart controls.

capabilities: Monitors the dsh web host process
Records crash details and recent logs
Automatically restarts the host with exponential backoff
Supports planned restarts through a panel and HTTP API
Runs an independent PowerShell supervisor process
Writes configuration and log files to a local data directory
